title: Standarijn
description: Everything you need for an SMP Survival or single-player world!

**Info:** This pack aims to maintain the original Minecraft experience while also providing optimization, quality of life and a bit of magical flavours!

**Quality of life:** Shaders/Mini map/Custom Screens/Essential/Zoom

**HOW TO INSTALL:**
**1:** Download the Modrinth app
**2:** Search for Standarijn and click install
**3:** Run the instance, check your settings / keybinds and have fun!
